absentmotion.description: AbsentMotion is a free, open-source alternative to CapCut and Alight Motion, combining video editing, motion graphics, and animation in one feature-packed editor. It offers a multi-layer timeline, precise keyframe controls, over 200 visual effects, vector editing, 3D animation, motion tracking, and advanced audio tools. Whether you're making quick edits or building complex animations, you get the creative freedom to work without subscriptions, paywalls, or locked features. Everything runs locally, including editing and rendering, with no account, ads, tracking, or internet connection required. Your projects stay on your device, fully under your control.
